assertions.statement: SoftBreakRun, HardBreakRun, HyperlinkRun, and MathRun exist with the exact registered names.
InlineRun contains all canonical rich variants and retains hyperlink and math semantic fields.
Unknown inline values fail explicitly and no generic payload or None fallback is used.
The RenderPlan module remains renderer-neutral and the A1M slice does not add a second caption source.
